title: What I build
subtitle: Business software built around your workflow, with no mandatory monthly subscription

services.title: Lawn Care Business Manager
services.description: A web application built around how a lawn care or landscaping company actually runs: properties, recurring services, crew scheduling, job completion and invoicing in one place. One-time development, self-hosted, no mandatory monthly subscription.
deliverables: Customer and property records with full service history
Online estimate requests, quotes and follow-up tracking
Recurring service schedules and crew day sheets
Mobile-friendly interface for crews in the field
Invoicing, payment status and customer notifications

services.title: Laravel Web Apps & SaaS
services.description: Custom web applications and multi-tenant SaaS products on Laravel: the data model, the API, subscription billing, roles and permissions, and the background jobs that keep it all moving. Built to be handed over and run on infrastructure you control.
deliverables: Multi-tenant architecture with roles and permissions
Subscription billing, plans and usage limits
REST or GraphQL API for web and mobile clients
Admin dashboard with the reports you actually read
Queues, scheduled jobs and third-party integrations
Automated tests and a repeatable deployment pipeline

services.title: Vue.js & Nuxt.js Web Apps
services.description: Front ends that stay fast as they grow: server-rendered Nuxt sites that search engines can actually read, dashboards that keep up with real data volumes, and a component system your team can extend without guessing.
deliverables: Server-rendered or static Nuxt build for SEO and speed
Reusable component library and design tokens
Auth flows, state management and API integration
Accessible, responsive layouts down to mobile
Core Web Vitals measured and tuned before handover

services.title: WordPress Website Development
services.description: Business websites and WooCommerce stores on WordPress, built as a custom theme rather than a stack of page-builder plugins. Your team gets an editor they can use; the site keeps its speed, its security updates and its search rankings.
deliverables: Custom theme built to your brand, no page-builder bloat
Editable pages and reusable blocks your team controls
WooCommerce storefront, checkout and payment setup
On-page SEO, structured data and analytics wired up
Speed, backups, security hardening and update routine
